name: Durable
description:
Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:
- You gain a +1 bonus to your Absorb.
- Once per round, when you use the Absorption feature, you may reduce the damage by your total Absorb.
- When you roll dice to regain hit points, you may reroll any 1s or 2s, taking the new value.
